      ∀ (u : Real),

          ∀ (x y : Fin n → Real) (trace : BlockDotProduct.RoundingTrace u),
            LT.lt.{0}
                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                  (↑(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (BlockDotProduct.treeDepth (BlockDotProduct.blockCount n T)))) u)
                1 →
              LT.lt.{0}
                  (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                    (↑(HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (BlockDotProduct.blockCount n T)) 1)) u)
                  1 →
                ∃ Δx Δy,
                  And

                      (∑ i, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (x i) (Δx i)) (y i)))
